About the Opportunity
The Strategic Initiatives Sr. provides operational and analytical support to Dayforce's M&A Integration and Business Integration team, supporting KPI tracking, deal reporting, and program operations across an active portfolio of M&A, transformation, and Long Range Plan (LRP) initiatives.
This role is the connective tissue of the team, helping maintain the data and dashboards that leadership relies on, coordinating across functions to keep workstreams moving, and translating detailed tracking into clear, digestible updates for stakeholders at every level.
This is an execution-focused, high-visibility role well suited to someone who wants to build a career in M&A integration or enterprise transformation. You will work closely with senior integration leaders, gaining exposure to live deals, executive reporting, and cross-functional problem-solving, with a clear growth path toward greater ownership of integration workstreams over time.
What You'll Get to Do

Support the ongoing tracking, validation, and maintenance of KPI frameworks and performance metrics across the M&A and transformation portfolio, helping ensure data is accurate, current, and audit-ready.
Help prepare and distribute bi-weekly and monthly reporting for active deals and initiatives, consolidating inputs from multiple workstreams into clear, consistent formats for leadership review.
Provide day-to-day operational support to the M&A and Business Integration team, including maintaining trackers, RAID logs, action item lists, and integration workplans.
Help build and maintain reporting dashboards, status decks, and executive-ready summaries that make complex, multi-workstream information easy to understand at a glance.
Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Technology, and Operations to gather updates, resolve data gaps, and keep reporting cycles on schedule.
Support the planning and execution of governance meetings, steering committee updates, and workstream check-ins, including agenda preparation and follow-up tracking.
Help identify opportunities to simplify and standardize recurring reporting and tracking processes, reducing manual effort and improving consistency across deals.
Conduct ad hoc data pulls and analysis to answer leadership questions and support decision-making on active integration and transformation initiatives.

Skills and Experience We Value

Three to five years of professional experience, ideally including exposure to project coordination, financial or operational reporting, program management, or business operations.
Demonstrated interest in building a career in M&A integration, enterprise transformation, or corporate strategy.
Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with the ability to build clean, accurate trackers, dashboards, and reporting decks.
Comfortable working with data, including pulling, validating, and organizing information from multiple sources into a single reliable source of truth.
Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across functions, gather input, resolve gaps, and keep multiple stakeholders aligned without formal authority.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines across multiple concurrent workstreams.
Ability to simplify complex information and distill detailed tracking and analysis into clear takeaways for a variety of audiences.
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships and influence outcomes without formal authority.
Ability to simplify complex, multi-source data into clear, actionable reporting for a range of stakeholders.
Strong analytical rigor with a focus on maintaining data accuracy and consistency across recurring reporting cycles.
Reliability and follow-through, with the ability to consistently deliver against recurring deadlines and proactively identify potential issues.
A growth-oriented mindset with an interest in gaining exposure to new areas of the M&A and transformation lifecycle and building toward broader integration responsibilities over time.

About the Opportunity
Help modernize and scale the workflow platform behind Dayforce.
We’re looking for a Senior Software Developer to join the Dayforce Platform Extensibility team and help evolve one of the most critical systems in Dayforce: Workflow. Our mission is to build scalable, extensible platform capabilities that reduce duplication and enable teams to move faster.
At the heart of what we build is the Dayforce Workflow platform—a scalable, rule-based workflow orchestration engine powering employee lifecycle processes across a multi-tenant SaaS platform used by millions globally.
We’re evolving Workflow into a reusable platform service with extensible APIs that support workflow capabilities across multiple Dayforce domains. As part of that evolution, we’re also investing in AI-enabled orchestration and intelligent automation experiences integrated directly into the platform.
This is a platform engineering role focused on solving complex challenges at enterprise scale—evolving foundational systems, building extensible platform capabilities, and shaping the future of workflow orchestration across Dayforce.
This is a full-stack role with a strong backend focus, where the most impactful work involves distributed systems, platform architecture, scalability, and backend engineering.
What You'll Get to Do

Own and evolve core capabilities within the Dayforce Workflow platform.
Contribute to AI-enabled orchestration and intelligent automation initiatives, leveraging AI as a force multiplier to evolve workflow capabilities and developer productivity across Dayforce.
Design and build scalable backend services, extensible APIs, and orchestration capabilities.
Improve the scalability, reliability, and performance of high-volume workflow systems.
Drive technical design, engineering standards, and operational excellence through modern development practices, observability, maintainability, and platform-focused architecture.
Mentor teammates, contribute to technical leadership, and help raise the engineering bar across the team.

Skills and Experience We Value
AI & Modern Development Tooling

Hands-on experience building or prototyping AI-enabled applications, agents, or orchestration workflows using LLMs and modern AI frameworks.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent as part of day-to-day development workflows and as a practical force multiplier for teams.

Backend & Platform Engineering

Strong experience building and maintaining production-grade enterprise applications with C#/.NET.
Experience designing scalable backend services, extensible APIs, and reusable platform capabilities.
Strong SQL Server expertise, including performance tuning, query optimization, concurrency, and troubleshooting at scale.
Experience building distributed, high-volume systems with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
Practical experience with Azure and modern cloud development patterns.

Engineering Mindset

Ability to communicate with clarity across all levels—from technical design discussions with engineers to translating platform strategy and trade-offs for leadership.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across backend systems, distributed services, and platform infrastructure.
Experience with modern development practices, CI/CD workflows, observability, structured logging, and operational reliability.
Strong engineering judgment—balancing scalability, maintainability, platform evolution, and pragmatic delivery.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience building or evolving workflow orchestration platforms or similar enterprise platform capabilities.
Experience developing reusable platform services and extensible APIs that support multiple product domains.
Experience applying AI-enabled orchestration or intelligent automation within enterprise software.
Experience providing technical leadership and mentoring engineers while remaining hands-on with development.

About the Opportunity
The Lead, Technology & Operational Risk is a senior individual contributor within Enterprise Risk Management responsible for translating real-world technology and operational signals into measurable enterprise risk insights. This role helps Dayforce better understand how systems are built, changed, operated, recovered, and connected across Product, Platform, Cybersecurity, and Operations.
Operating within the second line of defense, this role provides governance, challenge, integration, and technical credibility while ensuring risk ownership remains with the first-line teams that own products, platforms, services, controls, and remediation. This role contributes to advancing Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) from periodic, narrative-based reporting to more objective, signal-driven risk insights.
What You'll Get to Do

Support the development and ongoing management of technology and operational risk domains aligned to enterprise risk themes, including platform reliability, data integrity, dependency risk, change risk, service resilience, and operational disruption.
Translate enterprise risks into operational risk drivers, failure modes, system dependencies, and measurable indicators that reflect how Dayforce systems and processes operate in practice.
Develop and enhance Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) using objective signals from system performance, availability, incident trends, recovery behavior, change activity, capacity, scaling, observability, and third-party dependencies.
Partner with Product, Platform, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, and Major Incident Management teams to validate operational risks, confirm appropriate first-line ownership, and ensure risk signals are meaningful, actionable, and tied to business impact.
Connect major incidents, problem management trends, recurring failure patterns, and resilience gaps to enterprise risk insights, forward-looking indicators, and scenario analysis for high-impact technology risks.
Support the integration of ERM processes and tooling with operational and engineering data sources, ensuring technical risks are represented consistently in risk taxonomies, risk registers, dashboards, and systems of record.
Participate in risk councils and governance forums to challenge assumptions, normalize risk scoring, surface systemic dependencies, and provide technically grounded insights for executive and board-level risk discussions.
Support enterprise-wide risk initiatives across global financial and technology operations.
Contribute to the development, execution, and continuous improvement of technology and operational risk practices.
Lead cross-functional initiatives and coordinate with stakeholders across multiple business and technology teams.
Provide subject matter expertise and recommendations related to control standards and execution practices across multiple regulatory frameworks.
Support enterprise modernization of controls through automation and monitoring.

Skills and Experience We Value

Eight or more years of progressive experience in technology risk, operational risk, enterprise risk management, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, infrastructure, technology operations, large-scale SaaS operations, or a related area.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud platforms, operational resilience, incident management, observability, reliability engineering, service dependencies, change management, and technology failure modes.
Experience translating complex technical concepts, operational data, system behavior, and incident trends into business-relevant risk insights for senior leaders.
Strong understanding of enterprise risk management, operational risk practices, risk taxonomies, control environments, risk appetite, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and second-line governance expectations.
Demonstrated ability to develop metrics, thresholds, dashboards, reporting routines, or risk signal models that convert operational activity into measurable and actionable risk insights.
Ability to influence, challenge, and align senior technical and business stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment without direct ownership of remediation or operational execution.
Strong communication, facilitation, and executive storytelling skills, with the ability to connect technical details to enterprise-level risk exposure and decision-making.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Risk Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience supporting enterprise-wide technology and operational risk initiatives across global financial and technology operations.
Experience connecting major incidents, resilience gaps, and operational performance signals to enterprise risk reporting and scenario analysis.
Experience modernizing risk and control practices through automation, monitoring, and operational data.
Experience providing subject matter expertise across multiple regulatory and control frameworks.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional risk initiatives across complex business and technology environments.

Tax Resolution Specialist IV
About the opportunity
The Tax Resolution Specialist III is a client-facing role that acts as a liaison between the client and the tax agency. They help prepare & process amendments and/or research agency notices with precision. Their activities help to both satisfy agency requirements and prevent future issues. As such, this individual is responsible for maintaining good client standings with the respective tax agency.
What you will get to Do

Resolve and process tax jurisdiction correspondences/ amendment forms ranging from a simple to complex level.
Analyze and research issues that caused a tax agency to issue an out of compliance notification to customers. Review and investigate inquiries from tax authority agencies and respond promptly to resolve any discrepancies.
Prepare and file original and/ or amended for federal, SSA, states, and local tax returns.
Resolve client inquiries accurately and expediently with a high level of customer service.
Maintain contact and interact with any taxing agencies and authorities to obtain and analyze information necessary to complete tax filings.
Communicate with internal and external customers via phone, email, and fax to obtain information or required approvals for issues regarding tax jurisdiction or amendment correspondences.
Maintain a knowledge of agency requirements and forms; up-to-date knowledge of tax issues for Federal, states, and local taxing agencies and authorities. 
Read and comprehend information in electronic (computer) or paper form (written/ printed).
On an as-needed basis, assist with tax filing processing and may participate in cross training.
(Amendments) Understands the end-to-end amendment process, to include the preparation work behind the amendment.
Negotiate with agencies and customers to ensure that all involved are reasonably satisfied with the solution.
Maintain compliance and minimize tax risks by following strict policies. Must identify tax payments to reduce financial impact and tax penalties & interests.
Partners with other internal departments to resolve issues, remove barriers, establish service level agreements, and improve processes impacting the daily operation of the Dayforce Tax Services business.

Skills and experiences we value

Associate degree or equivalent 1 - 3 years of related tax / payroll / accounting experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
 American Payroll Association Certification – FPC Knowledge of federal, state and local tax laws is preferred.
 Good communication and interpersonal for both verbal and written skills are required and used extensively.
Comfortable in a fast-paced office environment performing multiple tasks cohesively, with keen attention to detail.
Detail oriented with the ability to accurately follow process, procedures and regulations in the workplace.
Strong organizational and follow up skills with a sense of urgency.
Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work on one’s own.

About the opportunity 
Want to build high-scale cloud systems that millions rely on every day? Come help us redefine what a great AI-powered Platform should be.
The Dayforce Talent Product Development team is seeking an experienced Senior Backend Software Developer to help build the next generation of intelligent, cloud-native Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions.
You will be joining the Dayforce Talent organization, the department responsible for our full portfolio of Talent products from Recruiting, Learning, Career Explorer, Performance Management, Compensation, and Succession - used globally by customers to hire, develop, and grow their workforce.
In this role, you will join high-performing teams that own the design, scalability, and optimization of backend services powering Talent experiences. You will solve complex technical challenges across distributed systems, drive meaningful architectural evolution, and help deliver product improvements that directly impact customer outcomes and support Dayforce’s competitiveness in the mid-market and enterprise Talent space.
As we scale our global product engineering model, this role will be based in our Mauritius office. 
You will work closely with peers in Mauritius during core hours, and engage with counterparts in North America, Europe, and other regions as needed.
What you'll get to do

Translate product requirements into scalable backend designs that deliver business value.
Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Architects, Test Engineers, UX Designers, and Software Engineers.
Provide technical leadership for backend architecture and design, guiding key decisions to ensure long-term scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
Analyze requirements, propose and evaluate solutions, produce clear architectural documentation, present designs, and achieve alignment across peers and stakeholders.
Design and optimize distributed backend systems using caching, partitioning, queuing, and performance engineering best practices.
Mentor and guide junior developers on backend design principles, coding best practices, and debugging strategies.
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve code quality, design patterns, and team performance.
Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through back-end automation, AI-assisted development, modern tooling, and adoption of DevOps practices.
Take ownership of backend feature development from concept to deployment, ensuring quality, performance, and observability.
Take responsibility for testing your code by writing and maintaining automated tests, validating backend functionality end-to-end, and ensuring high-quality code is delivered into production.
Contribute to improving team engineering practices and patterns through knowledge sharing and technical leadership.
Drive delivery excellence through reliable estimation, comprehensive backend test automation, and adherence to modern branching and work tracking practices.

Skills and experience we value

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Significant hands-on backend development experience in enterprise or SaaS environments, demonstrating technical ownership and delivery impact.
Strong object-oriented and backend programming skills using C#, .NET, or Java.
Experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native backend applications in production environments using cloud platforms (Azure or AWS) and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
Deep understanding of microservices and event-driven architectures, including REST/gRPC APIs and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Proficiency in SQL with familiarity in NoSQL data stores; strong understanding of backend data modeling and performance tuning.
Strong grasp of concurrency, distributed computing concepts, high-throughput system design, and performance optimization.
Skilled in applying backend-focused design patterns, system design principles, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency in writing automated backend tests (unit, integration, and functional) and ensuring testability through clean interfaces and reliable service contracts.
Solid understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and backend automation frameworks; knowledge of DevOps design patterns and operational best practices.
Experience working in agile development environments using Scrum or Kanban methodologies.
Curious and adaptable, with the ability to learn new backend technologies, frameworks, and APIs quickly. 
Familiarity with modern backend development tools such as Git, NuGet, or cloud-managed messaging platforms (e.g., Confluent Cloud).
Analytical, disciplined, and collaborative — able to solve complex backend problems and work effectively across global teams.

What would make you really stand out

Familiarity with ElasticSearch and modern backend-oriented test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, or SpecFlow.
Understanding of Talent, HR, or Workforce systems, with the ability to apply domain insights to backend system design decisions.

About the opportunity
The Managed Services Payroll Tax Analyst will provide tax support to clients in the areas of tax compliance, accurate submission of payroll taxes to tax filing, W2/YE balancing, client communication and will serve as a liaison in providing a point of contact for the client’s inquiries to include employee level payroll and tax filing. 
We are fully remote all of the time, not just in lockdowns. You can be based anywhere across Philippines. We are an amazing team, we ‘hum’ together, we lean into one another and have fun. We are flexible, we won’t micromanage you but we will provide you with structured growth.
What you will get to Do

Respond to and resolve our customers' inquiries via our CRM tool as outlined by our team’s guidelines.
Assess customer health using our team’s defined process to ensure we mitigate any risk to our business. 
Employee Tax Payroll Accuracy: Review and thoroughly audit payroll commits to ensure employees are taxed appropriately.
Payroll Tax Adjustments: Partner with customers and internal payroll teams to process payroll tax adjustments accurately.
Wage X Rate Audit: Conduct monthly audits to ensure customers' wages and rates are accurate.
Pre-funding Requests for Tax Agencies: Assist customers with timely and accurate pre-funding requests for stock transactions.
Monthly and Annual W-4 Form Exemptions: Review W-4 Form exemptions monthly to perform reasonability checks for customers' employees.
Tax and Compliance Changes: Stay up-to-date on tax and compliance changes and work with customers to ensure alignment.
Quarter/Year-End Balancing: Perform quarterly and year-end audits to balance customers' employees’ taxes, preventing W-2Cs.
Tax Code Fallouts: Review tax code fallouts weekly, work with customers to register accounts with applicable agencies, and reconcile any withheld deposits.
Amendment Requests: Work with customers and internal partners to process amendments promptly.
W-2/W-2C Forms: Collaborate with customers and internal teams to ensure W-2Cs are processed timely.
Lock-in Letters: Process IRS Form 2808 (Lock-in Letters) promptly to ensure compliance with IRS specifications for withholding allowances.

What’s in it for you 

Encouragement to be the best version of yourself at and away from work:

YOUnity diversity and inclusion programs
Amazing time away from work programs 

Support for your total well-being through our Live Well, Work Well programs targeting all aspects of your life
Recognition for your contributions through excellent pay, perks, and rewards
Giving where you’re living: volunteer days, Dayforce sponsored events, and our very own charity, Dayforce Cares
Opportunities to fuel your career growth through numerous internal and external programs and events

Skills and experiences we value

Experience: 3+ years required, 5+ years preferred in payroll tax, human resources, or payroll administration in a large, high-volume, multi-state environment.
Education: A high school diploma or GED is required. A bachelor’s degree in business, tax, human resources, or equivalent experience is desired.
Certifications: FPC or CPP certification required or commitment to obtain within two years of employment.
Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, time management skills, strong customer focus, analytical and problem-solving abilities, and the ability to work individually and in a team environment.
Knowledge: Demonstrated proficiency in auditing techniques or principles, detailed understanding of payroll and tax compliance, and knowledge of applying employee state and local taxation based on regulatory requirements.

What would make you really stand out 

Bachelor’s degree in business, tax, human resources or equivalent experience desired
FPC or CPP certification required or commitment to obtain within two years of employment 
Wage and tax balancing, federal, state, and local tax experience a plus

Work Timings : 9am-6pm Eastern Standard Time (EST)

About the Opportunity
The Dayforce Release and Configuration Management (RCM) team is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to support the Dayforce product line. Dayforce is a comprehensive, modern cloud Human Capital Management (HCM) SaaS platform that supports the entire employee lifecycle.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting configuration management processes and maintaining the infrastructure and tools that enable rapid development and software releases across the Dayforce platform. Working closely with Development, Support, and Operations teams, you will help ensure the delivery of high-quality software throughout the product lifecycle.
The Release and Configuration Management team supports Dayforce product and development teams as they build, test, and deploy both monolithic and microservices-based applications. The team defines, manages, monitors, and reports on development and quality assurance environments, software branches, builds, and deployments while also developing tools that support engineering teams across the organization.
This role supports U.S. Government projects. Candidates must be U.S. citizens, naturalized citizens, permanent residents, or green card holders, and must be eligible to obtain U.S. security clearance.
What You'll Get to Do

Partner with product teams to deliver high-quality software on schedule.
Take ownership of the integrity of source control and build environments.
Maintain and improve the process for releasing builds into QA, Development, and Test environments.
Maintain and improve the process for releasing software to customers, including patches and maintenance releases.
Manage release and development branches, including tagging, merging, and applying configuration management best practices.
Maintain and support Development and QA/Development/Test infrastructure deployments.
Improve build configuration and automation to efficiently manage software releases.
Mentor junior team members on DevOps best practices and process improvements.
Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives across development and release processes.
Participate in the Architecture Review Board (ARB) to support the successful integration of new projects.

Skills and Experience We Value

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience with the software development lifecycle.
Experience using configuration management tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet.
Experience with build automation tools such as Octopus, PowerShell, or Jenkins.
Experience working with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Experience with source control management practices and advanced branching strategies using Git, GitHub, TFVC, or Bitbucket.
Experience administering application lifecycle management tools such as TFS, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jira.
Proficiency with SQL and a solid understanding of relational database systems.
Experience defining and improving software build, deployment, and release processes.
Experience supporting .NET application development.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
Experience working in an Agile software development environment.
Experience with server administration and cloud hosting practices in a Microsoft environment.

What Would Make You Stand Out

Experience supporting enterprise-scale SaaS platforms.
Experience working with both monolithic and microservices-based applications.
Experience building and maintaining internal DevOps tools and automation.
Experience improving release management processes and deployment efficiency.
Experience mentoring engineers and promoting DevOps best practices across development teams.

About the Opportunity
The Senior Business Insights Consultant, Global Enablement is a strategic individual contributor responsible for transforming operational data into actionable business insights that drive performance across the Global Enablement organization. This role serves as the trusted analytics partner for Enablement and Operations leadership by providing visibility into workforce performance, case distribution, productivity, operational health, and global enablement key performance indicators (KPIs).
The role combines business acumen, analytics expertise, and strategic thinking to identify opportunities, influence decision-making, and improve operational effectiveness. The Senior Business Insights Consultant develops enterprise reporting solutions, establishes performance measurement frameworks, and delivers recommendations that support workforce optimization, operational excellence, and organizational strategy.
What You'll Get to Do

Strategic Business Insights

Serve as the primary analytics partner to Global Enablement leadership by delivering meaningful operational and strategic insights.
Translate complex business questions into analytical solutions that support executive decision-making.
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities using quantitative and qualitative analysis.
Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders in a clear and compelling manner.




Workforce Performance Analytics

Develop and maintain performance scorecards that measure productivity, utilization, efficiency, quality, and capacity across the Global Enablement organization.
Analyze workforce trends to identify opportunities for improved performance and resource optimization.
Support workforce planning through forecasting, capacity modeling, and productivity analysis.
Recommend performance improvement initiatives based on analytical findings.




Operational Effectiveness

Analyze operational performance across the Global Enablement organization to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Monitor workload balancing, backlog trends, aging, throughput, productivity, and overall operational outputs.
Evaluate operational processes and recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes.
Measure operational effectiveness through data-driven performance indicators and provide actionable recommendations to leadership.
Partner with cross-functional teams to identify process optimization opportunities and support continuous improvement initiatives.


Executive KPI Management

Design, implement, and govern Global Enablement KPIs aligned with organizational objectives.
Build executive dashboards and performance scorecards that provide real-time visibility into business health.
Standardize KPI definitions and reporting methodologies across the organization.
Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and governance.


Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop scalable dashboards and automated reporting solutions using business intelligence tools.
Improve reporting efficiency through automation and process optimization.
Maintain documentation for metrics, reporting logic, and dashboard governance.
Ensure data quality and integrity across reporting environments.




Cross-Functional Partnership

Collaborate with Operations, Workforce Management, Business Intelligence, Finance, Product, and Business Systems teams.
Support strategic initiatives through analytical modeling and business case development.
Influence operational improvements through data-driven recommendations.
Act as a subject matter expert for operational analytics within Global Enablement.




Continuous Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes and eliminate manual effort.
Champion data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Introduce best practices in business intelligence, visualization, and performance management.
Evaluate emerging analytical tools and methodologies that improve organizational insight.



Skills and Experience We Value

6 years of experience in Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Operations Analytics, or a related field.
Experience supporting global operations, customer support, enablement, or shared services organizations.
Experience developing executive dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience influencing business decisions through analytical insights.
Experience with workforce management concepts including forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and productivity measurement.
Experience working with CRM or case management platforms such as Salesforce, Dayforce Case Management, or ServiceNow.
Advanced experience using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent visualization platforms.
Strong SQL and data modeling experience.
Experience with enterprise data warehouses and cloud analytics platforms.
Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or operational excellence methodologies.

About the Opportunity
Dayforce is currently seeking a Full-Time Salaried Payroll Delivery Manager I to join our Dayforce Managed Team. The role focuses on collaborative leadership of Payroll specialists for an assigned book of clients. We service our clients by supporting the complete employee life cycle including payroll, workforce management, benefits, and contact center; allowing the client to focus on their core business.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in effectively managing clients’ relationships, support process sustainability, indirectly managing the payroll specialists and being a strong consultative partner. About the Opportunity
We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on AI Engineer Sr. to design, build, and scale enterprise AI solutions that drive innovation across the organization. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who is passionate about applying Generative AI to solve real business problems and enjoys building production-ready systems.
You will play a key role in developing our AI platform, enabling AI-powered applications, and building intelligent agents that improve productivity and business outcomes. Working closely with Engineering and Architecture teams, you will help define best practices for AI development while ensuring solutions are secure, observable, scalable, and reusable.
The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in modern AI frameworks, agentic architectures, and cloud-native development, along with a passion for building AI-powered capabilities that create lasting business value and leveraging AI to improve software development and engineering productivity.
What You'll Get to Do

Design, develop, and deploy production-grade AI applications, intelligent agents, and agentic workflows using modern AI frameworks.
Build and enhance reusable AI platform components, SDKs, libraries, and services that accelerate AI development across engineering teams.
Develop scalable orchestration frameworks for AI agents, tool integration, retrieval pipelines, evaluation harnesses, and model interactions.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
Six or more years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience building scalable, distributed applications.
Two or more years of hands-on experience developing production AI or Generative AI applications.

About the Opportunity
The U.S. Emerging Markets Account Executive role provides a unique opportunity to join the top achieving business unit and fastest growing organization within Dayforce sales. This team focuses on delivering best-in-class HCM solutions within a highly collaborative and performance-driven environment.
The Account Executive – Emerging Markets is responsible for selling Dayforce’s HCM solutions to mid-market companies within their assigned geography, while also developing and fostering new referral and influence partner relationships. This role requires prior experience selling Human Capital Management (HCM) software solutions and the ability to manage a high-velocity sales cycle with complexity, balancing speed with a strategic, consultative approach to HCM solution selling.
This is a virtual (digital-first) role, remote-based with minimal to moderate travel required depending on assigned territory. The segment focus is organizations with 500–999 employees.
